newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Jan 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Jan 14.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Th cabinet on Monday endorsed a proposal that the source of black money, if invested in industrial sector, would not be questioned by the government for the next three years.
Ruling Awami League and the opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) meets on Tuesday to end the impasse resulting from BNP's continuing boycott of the parliament.
The cabinet has approved the proposal for making investment in education sector tax free.
Cargo handling at the Chittagong Port has been facing serious disruptions for the last 12 days due to "go slow" programme by the dock workers to press the demand for higher wages.
The government will implement a $125 million project in next two years to improve traffic system in capital Dhaka.
The French government has hailed the recently signed treaty on sharing of the Ganges water between Bangladesh and India.
A Thai company will soon start commercial production and marketing of flowers in cooperation with with a local firm.
Peasants anf fertiliser dealers of 16 northern districts of the country have expressed apprehension of a urea crisis in the current paddy season.
